performances.title: Everything In Its Right Place

based.label: Radiohead — Everything In Its Right Place

performances.device: Desktop (Windows, D3D11) + ROLI Piano + ROLI Airwave
performances.notes: The ROLI Piano lays the chords on the grid while the Airwave's hands drive the vortex and the swirl over them (DECISIONS_4 #69).

performances.title: Autumn Leaves
performances.device: Galaxy Tab (Android, GLES 3) + Odisei Travel Sax + joystick
performances.notes: Wind mode: one voice, breath as the ink feed, every legato change a wake dragging the drop to the next note (#63).

performances.title: La Guaracha
performances.synth: GarageBand — custom harp, tuned to sound like the arpa chiquitana
performances.notes: Every note on all three rows of its parity — the whole Jankó lattice stays live under ten fingers.

performances.title: Canon in D
performances.notes: The roll's now-line births every note and the sheet drifts away with the tempo — the timeline of the canon.

performances.title: The Jaffer tribute — Ali Paşa
performances.notes: The Jaffer tribute: Ali Paşa is the tune Aubrey Jaffer set his single-stylus Latte marbling animation to, performed here on the instrument built from his equations — the melody walks the dial in fifths. See the gallery page's tribute section.

performances.title: A discharge — Anod, the electric medium
performances.device: Desktop (macOS, Metal) + ROLI Seaboard + ROLI Airwave
performances.notes: Every strike a spark on its charge, the per-note bend stirring the Chladni eddies, the mod wheel throwing the standard map on the glass while the same wheel sweeps the rotor's K in the sound — one theorem, two senses.

performances.title: The trumpet — partials under the valves
performances.notes: The eight partials on the ring, the three valve pads at the side; every held note retunes as the valves change, and Suzu's lips follow the slide of the finger as the embouchure.

performances.title: The bowed string draws itself
performances.synth: Voxo — Suzu, the modal harmonic string under the breath bow
performances.notes: Breath holds the partials on the bow's servo while the orbit trace lays each voice's phase portrait into the water at its string — the synth marbling with its own state.

performances.title: The theremin — five octaves under one finger
performances.notes: The whole width is the instrument: a touch glides across five octaves and re-anchors past 47 semitones; pushing away feeds the drop, pulling back stirs it.

performances.title: Wicki–Hayden — chords on the button-field
performances.notes: Every note has exactly one button, a fifth up-right and a fourth up-left, so a chord is the same shape in every key; the bend runs up the pitch plane.

performances.title: The trombone — the slide and the S Pen
performances.device: Galaxy Tab S8 Ultra (Android, GLES 3) + S Pen
performances.notes: Seven partials on the ring, the slide along the bottom; the pen plays the partials and a finger works the slide between its phrases — the Tab's palm rejection keeps the two apart.

performances.title: The flute — breath and the overblow
performances.notes: The jet and the bore under a real breath: soft blowing sits flat, hard blowing jumps the octave by itself, and the scope draws the bore's phase plane over the water.

performances.title: Chladni — a vibrato winds the keys
performances.notes: Under Anod the per-note bend stirs the eddies: a vibrato turns every key back and forth and comes home, a held bend winds the ink from the key's edge into the figure.

performances.title: Watch it again — one recording, three devices
performances.notes: The iPad's recording replayed on the desktop, re-sounding through Suzu, and in the browser as the picture alone — the same bytes at the same frame boundaries on three GPUs.
